candidate.featureDescription: Allow workspace admins to invite multiple colleagues at once.

productContext.constraints: Existing tested bulk-invite service; one engineer available
No invite service; security review required; no engineers available this quarter

signals.title: FICTIONAL evaluation evidence
signals.body: In this synthetic scenario, 8 of 10 observed admins needed to invite 20+ colleagues, abandoned repetitive invites, and requested bulk entry.

signals.title: FICTIONAL conflicting evidence
signals.body: In this synthetic scenario, two smaller teams said bulk entry would add no value.
